task.title: Constrain user-config doc targets to the project directory
task.description:
DocTargets and SkillDir from the user configuration are joined against the project root without validation (internal/agentdocs/operations.go:202,220), so a value such as "../../.bashrc" writes outside the repository.

Only the local user can author ~/.config/workbook/config.json, so this is a footgun rather than a trust-boundary crossing: a typo or a copied config silently writes managed documentation outside the project. It is worth closing before a beta ships configuration examples that people copy between machines, because managed docs are written by an automated path where nobody is inspecting the destination.

Acceptance:
- Doc target and skill directory paths are rejected unless they resolve inside the project directory, using filepath.IsLocal or an equivalent check.
- The error names the offending configured value and the layer it came from.
- A test covers a traversal value in both DocTargets and SkillDir.
